title: Speaking — Explaining an idea
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on explaining an idea.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
Do you like explaining something you know well?
How do you tell whether another person understands you?

part2.topic: Describe a time when you explained a difficult idea successfully.
points: what example or method you used
part2.closing: and explain why the explanation worked.

questions: What makes public information on complex subjects clear and trustworthy?
How can teachers encourage students to ask for clarification?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to explaining an idea?
